title: Dynamic scaling of geospatial data on maps

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: displaying geospatial object markers over a map
changing marker size in response to map zoom level
using threshold regions between minimum and maximum marker scales
using marker type, marker density, or screen resolution when determining scaling behavior
allowing different marker types to use different scaling functions and thresholds
preserving high-level pattern visibility while reducing marker overlap and clutter

scope_model.analysis_loop: receive authorized geospatial objects -> compute viewport and density context -> resolve marker policy by type -> calculate marker size within bounded scale rules -> render map/layers -> update on pan/zoom while preserving readability
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: separate geographic coordinates from visual marker-size policy
derive marker presentation from zoom, density, marker type, and display characteristics
use bounded minimum and maximum display sizes
support independently configurable scaling curves per layer/type
measure overlap and readability rather than deleting source objects from the data model
keep rendering logic independent from any operational decision logic

independent_claim_themes: marker-size changes based on map scale and marker type/density/resolution
different scaling behavior for multiple marker types
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

mandatory_safety_boundaries: no person identification or covert tracking
